name: EDP - Energias de Portugal
tagline: Integrating AI-driven smart building solutions for legacy equipment optimization in European buildings

kpis.explanation_fr: EBITDA recurrent = KPI cardinal EDP (hors elements exceptionnels, Asset Rotation gains). 5.0 Mds EUR en 2025 (+1% YoY).
kpis.explanation_en: Recurring EBITDA = EDP cardinal KPI (excl exceptional items, Asset Rotation gains). EUR 5.0 Bn in 2025 (+1% YoY).
kpis.signal: Recurring EBITDA tient malgre Iberian blackout April 2025 + market volatility. Driver = EDPR + Iberian Generation Q4.

kpis.explanation_fr: EBITDA Iberia = activite historique EDP. 54% du EBITDA Groupe en 2025. Modele regule networks + Generation hydro/renewables.
kpis.explanation_en: Iberia EBITDA = EDP historical activity. 54% of Group EBITDA in 2025. Regulated networks model + hydro/renewables generation.
kpis.signal: Iberia reste majoritaire (54%). Portugal vise 3 Mds EUR capex Networks. RAB augmente sur 2026-2028 reglementation favorable.

kpis.explanation_fr: EBITDA Amerique Nord = activite Renewables via EDPR aux US. 22% du EBITDA Groupe. Plan 2026-2028 = 60% du capex EDPR (focus US apres Inflation Reduction Act + projets storage).
kpis.explanation_en: North America EBITDA = Renewables activity via EDPR in US. 22% Group EBITDA. 2026-2028 plan = 60% EDPR capex (US focus post Inflation Reduction Act + storage projects).
kpis.signal: Croissance attendue + grace au One Big Beautiful Bill Act (juillet 2025). Storage = 60% capex EDPR 2026-2028.

kpis.explanation_fr: Capacite totale installee EDP. 32.7 GW dont quasiment tout en Renewables post sortie charbon Sines 2025.
kpis.explanation_en: Total EDP installed capacity. 32.7 GW with quasi-all in Renewables post Sines coal exit 2025.
kpis.signal: 32.7 GW : tres majoritaire renouvelable (hydro + wind onshore + solar). 1er pays UE 100% coal-free generation (Portugal).

kpis.explanation_fr: Politique de dividende EDP : 60-70% du net income (recurrent) en payout. KPI structurel + signal capital return aux actionnaires.
kpis.explanation_en: EDP dividend policy: 60-70% recurring net income payout. Structural KPI + capital return signal to shareholders.
kpis.signal: TSR 2025 = 2eme meilleur Europe apres banques. Dividende ancre comme premium yield utility.

kpis.explanation_fr: EDP au Bresil depuis 30 ans (celebration 2025). Distribution Sao Paulo + transmission. 17% du EBITDA Groupe.
kpis.explanation_en: EDP in Brazil for 30 years (2025 celebration). Sao Paulo distribution + transmission. 17% Group EBITDA.
kpis.signal: Bresil = 3eme contributeur EBITDA. Framework reglementaire stable. Long-term visibility.

kpis_story.description_fr: Blackout iberique en avril 2025 a affecte jusqu'a 1 million de clients EDP en pic. Coordination Government + management excedentaire eau via hydro EDP a permis reponse efficace. Stress-test grandeur nature reseau electrique iberique.
kpis_story.description_en: April 2025 Iberian blackout affected up to 1M EDP clients at peak. Government coordination + EDP hydro plant excess water management enabled effective response. Large-scale stress test of Iberian electrical grid.

kpis_story.description_fr: Centrale charbon Sines fermee fin 2025. Portugal devient 1er pays UE 100% coal-free generation. Premium ESG story pour utility europeenne.
kpis_story.description_en: Sines coal plant closed end-2025. Portugal becomes 1st EU country with 100% coal-free generation. Premium ESG story for European utility.

company_description: EDP, S.A. engages in the generation, transmission, distribution, and supply of electricity in Portugal, Spain, France, Poland, Romania, Italy, Belgium, the United Kingdom, Greece, Colombia, Brazil, North America, and internationally. It operates through Renewables, Networks, and Client Solutions & Energy Management segments. The company generates and sells electricity through hydro, combined-cycle gas turbine, coal, wind, solar, nuclear, and cogeneration and waste sources. The company is also involved in the supply of natural gas. In addition, it offers engineering, laboratory tests, professional training, and energy services, as well as property management services. The company was formerly known as EDP - Energias de Portugal, S.A. and changed its name to EDP, S.A. in April 2024. The company was incorporated in 1976 and is headquartered in Lisbon, Portugal.
